# Changelog

<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/changelog.py (make changelog) from merged pull requests,
     release tags and docs/releases.toml. Don't edit by hand: spec 08 §Release, decision-023. -->

Every pull request merged into `dev` (or, outside a promotion, into `main`), by release. The backend
and the frontend share one semver version, tagged `vX.Y.Z` on `main`. The version never decides which
papers a query matches: a search record pins its `index_version`, `tokenizer_version` and
`query_version`, and replays as `reproduced` while its index is kept and the running release can serve
it with the same QUERY_VERSION; otherwise as `drifted`, naming what changed. Each release's Data section
names the index it was verified on and which saved records still reproduce.

### Data

- index_version `78d2e70310f3`, snapshot `03eab0ef56c4d768ca25c1942207d1c9eaf14a1d852bd276a05e013ae17210c7`
- TOKENIZER_VERSION 3 · SCHEMA_VERSION 4 · Tantivy 0.26.2 · QUERY_VERSION 2
- Search records saved under 0.3.0 replay as `reproduced` on the index_version they pin, while it is kept and supported and QUERY_VERSION matches. Earlier records also require a supported retained pin and matching QUERY_VERSION; release tables alone do not determine replay status.
- Verified on the served index 78d2e70310f3 of the 173,518-paper snapshot of 2026-10-16, in which AIES 2026 (Vol. 9) joins the corpus (TASK-217). It is built with the same tokenizer, schema, query and Tantivy versions as 0.3.0, so search records saved on a retained supported index still replay as reproduced. The question of OpenAlex's terms (TASK-135) is still open: it has yet to go to the university copyright office, the public launch waits on its answer, and the OpenAlex abstract fill is unchanged until then. Promotion does not deploy data.

## 0.3.0

### Data

- index_version `b4f335e07e70`, snapshot `93c2937e2f2936b851feb29b4e82114dd0c7c0a99de00500bfe2f2fb457e7ccb`
- TOKENIZER_VERSION 3 · SCHEMA_VERSION 4 · Tantivy 0.26.2 · QUERY_VERSION 2
- Replay against changed inputs reports `drifted` (SCHEMA_VERSION 3 → 4). Retained supported pins reproduce when QUERY_VERSION matches; incompatible pins require the matching historical release.
- Verified on a new schema-4 index of the 173,253-paper snapshot of 2026-10-11: AAAI (1980+), AIES, FAccT and IASEAI join the corpus (decision-049), 4,536 AAAI 1980-2008 papers gain AAAI's own abstracts from archived aaai.org pages (decision-051) and 1,117 gain labelled OpenAlex abstracts (abstract_kind:openalex). Default searches shrank where AAAI 1980-2008 and AIES 2018-2023 entries outside the technical program took their own tracks (decision-050: 1,197 track changes, 39 not-paper removals), so a search record saved on an earlier index replays as drifted, naming each removed paper's cause. Index schema 2 is retired; schema-3 indexes stay replayable. Promotion does not deploy data; because SCHEMA_VERSION changes, deploying this release needs index b4f335e07e70 with it (spec 08 §Release step 9).
